title: SingelPortalen
summary: A multilingual, real-time chat platform with Admin, Agent and Customer roles, credit-based messaging, live communication and agent earnings.
challenge: The product needed real-time customer-agent communication while controlling paid messaging through a credit model and supporting multiple languages.
solution: Built role-based Admin, Agent and Customer workflows.
Added English and Swedish multilingual support.
Implemented free messages followed by paid credits, with each paid message consuming one credit.
Integrated CCBill for credit purchases and built wallet, favorites and agent earnings features.
outcomes: Implemented a complete credit wallet and paid messaging model.
Added administrative monitoring for users and chat activity.
